pull.q: A very interesting and clever designed module.

quotes.t: The 321 is entirely DC coupled, allowing the process of control voltages as well as audio signals.

reviews.title: Frap Tools New 321 Scale + Flip + Shift + Combine Cleverly Simplifies The Work Of Audio & Control Voltages In Eurorack
Frap Tools 321 Module Lets You Slap It Up, Flip It, Rub It Down

videos.title: Frap Tools 321 Scale + Flip + Shift + Combine

blurb.en: Three identical scale/flip/shift sections, DC-coupled for CV or audio, summed two ways into a full mix and an unpatched-only mix.
blurb.fi: Kolme identtistä scale/flip/shift-osiota, DC-kytketty CV:lle tai audiolle, summattu kahdella tavalla: täysi mix ja pelkkien kytkemättömien kanavien mix.
blurb.sv: Tre identiska scale/flip/shift-sektioner, DC-kopplade för CV eller audio, summerade på två sätt: en full mix och en mix av bara de opatchade kanalerna.
